title: senecio erucifolius var. arenarius
intro: Senecio erucifolius var. arenarius, commonly known as the Ragwort or Sea Ragwort, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family. Traditionally, this plant has been used for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues, such as constipation and stomach pain. The therapeutic actions of Senecio erucifolius var. arenarius are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antispasmodic. Research suggests that the bioactive constituents of this plant, including sesquiterpene lactones and alkaloids, may contribute to its medicinal properties.
